data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in CPHC, ALCO, and IPI.

CPHC had a new Schedule 13D (activist-style) ownership filing on October 1, 2026 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1672909/000139834426017759/0001398344-26-017759-index.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and offer a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
